prompts.text: What does the work do on the surface?
What becomes possible for someone who encounters it?
My three-line myth: what it is · what it stands for · what it makes possible.

blocks.title: Three lines
blocks.instruction: Write exactly three lines. No origin story, brand language, or proof. Read them aloud and listen for the line with gravity.

blocks.closing: Let the myth remain larger than the pitch.
